[[Larnaca]] | capacity = 5,500 | chairman = Vacant | manager = [[Alexandros Garpozis|Alexis Garpozis]] | league = {{Cypriot football updater|Karmiotissa}} | season = {{Cypriot football updater|Karmiotissa2}} | position = {{Cypriot football updater|Karmiotissa3}} | website = {{URL|karmiotissafc.football}} | pattern_la1 = _macronalioth22ob | pattern_b1 = _macronalioth22ob | pattern_ra1 = _macronalioth22ob | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | body1 = FF5500 | leftarm1 = FF5500 | rightarm1 = FF5500 | shorts1 = FF5500 | socks1 = FF5500 | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _black_nzfc_shoulders | pattern_ra2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF }} '''Karmiotissa Football Club''' ({{langx|el|Καρμιώτισσα Πολεμιδιών|Karmiotissa Polemidion}}) is a [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Pano Polemidia]], Limassol, Cyprus. They compete in the [[Cypriot First Division]]. The club's colors are orange and white. The home ground of the football team is the Community Stadium of Pano Polemidia.{{Cite web |title=ΚΑΡΜΙΩΤΙΣΣΑ ΠΟΛΕΜΙΔΙΩΝ (Karmiòtissa) |url=http://www.cfa.com.cy/?lang=Gr&show=profile&ClubID=508 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110913182526/http://www.cfa.com.cy/?lang=Gr&show=profile&ClubID=508 |archive-date=13 September 2011 |access-date=7 October 2015 |publisher=[[Cyprus Football Association|CFA]]}} In the 2022–23 season, they mostly played in [[Stelios Kyriakides Stadium]] in [[Paphos]]. The club's name comes from the chapel of [[Virgin Mary]] Karmiotissa located in [[Pano Polemidia]].{{Cite web |title=Το "ερυθρόλευκο" θαύμα |url=http://sentragoal.philenews.com/article.asp?catid=18868&subid=2&pubid=129060459 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160103182730/http://goal.philenews.com/article.asp?catid=18868&subid=2&pubid=129060459 |archive-date=2016-01-03 |access-date=2015-10-07}} Cypriot businessman Stavros Demosthenous owned the club from 2023 until his death in 2025."}}
